gbm_population_evidence.quote: Healthcare providers (including but not limited to physicians and nurses) who see gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (GBM) will be randomly assigned
Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP); Counseling; Sexual and Gender Minorities

coder_notes: Not a glioblastoma trial: 'GBM' here means gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (HIV PrEP counselling study). Behavioural intervention only; no drug interventions. The OTHER arm 'Care as usual' serves as the control. Treatment setting not applicable to this population; coded unclear.
